freeTierSummary.en: 10,000 free Neurons per day on the Workers Free plan (resets daily at 00:00 UTC), covering 50+ open models. No credit card required. Usage beyond the free allocation is billed at $0.011 per 1,000 Neurons. Replace {account_id} in the base URL with your Cloudflare account ID.
freeTierSummary.zh-CN: Workers Free 计划每天 10,000 Neurons 免费推理额度（每日 00:00 UTC 重置），覆盖 50+ 开源模型，免信用卡。超额后按 $0.011 / 1000 Neurons 计费。接入时把 baseUrl 中的 {account_id} 换成你的 Cloudflare 账户 ID。
